task: Add PMTiles display products for all prepared datasets and data-driven GRWL width visualization
authorizations: User explicitly requested PMTiles for all current prepared products; local work only.
outputs: Reuse existing GRWL and river-plastic PMTiles bytes
New LakeATLAS polygons and pour-points PMTiles
GRWL line thickness and legend driven by width_mean in metres
immutability: Never modify existing analytical release bytes or historical evidence.
Add publication.display reference to versioned display manifest in each canonical dataset.yaml; do not add a separate editable dataset inventory.
New display files live under product/display/display-v1; no invented public-hosting status.
validation: Validate pinned input hashes, exact source row counts, schema, ID uniqueness and field semantics before conversion.
All eligible source IDs must be accounted for at maximum zoom; empty/zero-length/quantization-collapse exceptions must be identified explicitly and never hidden as complete coverage.

Validate selected tile attributes against source by ID, including null omissions. Decode all maxzoom IDs; test fixed regions and stable source-ID samples for geometry fidelity with a predeclared 30 m maximum zoom display tolerance in Web Mercator. Quantization and simplification affect tiles only.
Run actual pmtiles verify, validate layer IDs, zoom metadata, bounds, source IDs and exact output hashes. Do not relabel failed attempts as passing.
Fixture rebuilds must be byte-identical from a clean checkout. Production build/rebuild scope must be stated honestly.

All six default map layers must use PMTiles, render nonzero features in fresh Chrome contexts, and use cross-origin HTTP206 ranges without full-file GETs. Evaluate global and regional controls; 128 MiB data-body ceiling per case.

GRWL style must produce different visible widths for 50 m, 200 m and 1000 m at the same zoom, with explicit missing-value handling, units, and notice of cartographic exaggeration. Browser test must establish active paint expression uses width_mean.
PMTiles feature inspection retains unique source identity; the existing all-attributes action continues to query GeoParquet for new tile layers. Test click/lookup after switching layers.
Publication preparation and viewer mapping reject missing or modified display files, source-release mismatches and unsafe paths; canonical/index/catalog checks remain clean.

cartography.drop_policy: Explicit per-feature minimum zoom only; no arbitrary feature/tile-size dropping; disable tiny-polygon area aggregation. Report quantization collapse explicitly.

cost_guardrails.network: Small pinned dependencies only; reuse all dataset bytes; no GEE, uploads, cloud compute or bulk downloads.

design_intent.human: Nathan reviewing global hydrology products for publication
design_intent.action: Browse all datasets globally and see how measured river width differs along GRWL segments
design_intent.signature: Measured mean-width legend tied to active paint and clicked source values
defaults_replaced: Uniform river stroke becomes width_mean-driven symbols
Fixed-count Parquet preview becomes zoom-dependent PMTiles
Raw unlabeled widths become metres with an explicit screen-scale caveat
design_intent.typography: Existing system sans and tabular IDs
